pages.text: A Cleansegleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a blue-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When activated, a Cleansegleam will purge the user of Hunger, Nausea, and Poison at the cost of a point of charge.$(br2)If activated while sneaking, you can attempt to all targets within three blocks of you of these effects instead.
Any target affected by a Cleansegleam will also be immunized from poison for 60 seconds.
pages.title: Potion Core

pages.text: To recharge a dun Cleansegleam, activate the gem while you have a bucket of milk in your inventory. The milk is consumed, and the bucket is returned. Alternatively, if you have a $(l:items/radiant_amphora)Radiant Amphora$() linked to a $(l:blocks/radiant_tank)Radiant Tank$() containing milk, the milk is deducted from the tank directly.
